The Capri Warehouse Ritual — GTA 6 guide

Reported by a published guide · not personally verified Abandoned warehouse near Tortoise Lake, northern Capri

A warehouse in northern Capri has a circle on the floor that someone used for dark purposes.

Full guide — contains spoilers

Inside an abandoned warehouse near Tortoise Lake in northern Capri is a ritual circle or pentagram. Carry an unconscious or dead passer-by onto the circle to start a supernatural sequence that works for both Jason and Lucia. Game8's account adds that you must push through hallucinations and burn the demon with molotovs or gasoline to escape, earning The Truth Is Out There trophy.

Source & evidence

Source: GTA 6 Easter eggs and secrets: all finds — gta.guide (2026-11-23).

Evidence: Guide note with location and trigger; escape sequence corroborated by Game8. Two guides describe the same site with slightly different framing.
